data.gender_notes: Azrik is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Azrik is a Hebrew name with the meaning 'My strength is God'. This name appears in the Bible as the name of an unidentified man who, along with his wife, dedicated his child to God in 2 Chronicles 23:17. The name Azrik carries the meaning “My strength is God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in Hebrew, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Azrik usually hope their child will grow to embody my strength is god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies reliance and trust in God's strength

in_hebrew.name: עזריק
in_hebrew.meaning: עזריק: עזר אלוהים, עזר מן האל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: עזריק הוא שם עברי שפירושו 'עזר אלוהים' או 'עזר מן האל'. השם עזריק מורכב משתי מילים: 'עזר' שפירושו עזרה או תמיכה, ו'אל' או 'אלוהים' שפירושו אלוהים. השם עזריק מביע את הרעיון של עזרה אלוהית או תמיכה מאלוהים. השם נמצא בשימוש בקרב הקהילות היהודיות והנוצריות כאחד, ומשמעותו רוחנית ומעודדת.

in_greek.name: Αζρικός
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο Αζρικός είναι ένα όνομα που προέρχεται από την εβραϊκή γλώσσα και σημαίνει 'βοήθεια Θεού' ή 'Θεομήτορ'. Το όνομα Αζρικός αποτελείται από δύο λέξεις: 'עזר' που σημαίνει βοήθεια ή υποστήριξη και 'אל' ή 'אלוהים' που σημαίνει Θεός. Το όνομα Αζρικός εκφράζει την ιδέα της θεϊκής βοήθειας ή υποστήριξης. Το όνομα χρησιμοποιείται τόσο στις εβραϊκές όσο και στις χριστιανικές κοινότητες, και η σημασία του είναι πνευματική και ενθαρρυντική.

in_latin.name: Azricus
in_latin.long_meaning: Azricus nomen est hebraicum quod significat 'Dei auxilium' vel 'Deus adiutor'. Nomen Azricus ex duabus vocibus constat: 'עזר' quod significat auxilium vel adiutorium, et 'אל' vel 'אלוהים' quod significat Deus. Nomen Azricus exprimit ideam auxilii divini vel adiutorii a Deo. Nomen in usu est apud communitates tam iudaicas quam christianas, et significatio eius est spiritualis et exhortativa.

in_english.name: Azrik
in_english.meaning: Divine helper, God is my aid
in_english.long_meaning: The name Azrik originates from Hebrew roots, specifically from the words 'ezar' meaning 'help' or 'aid' and 'El' or 'Elohim' meaning 'God'. Azrik signifies 'divine helper' or 'God is my aid'. It conveys the spiritual significance of being assisted or supported by God. Historically, names with similar roots have been used in both Jewish and Christian traditions to signify a connection to divine providence. The name Azrik is not commonly found in biblical texts but carries a profound spiritual meaning related to faith and divine support. In modern usage, Azrik is chosen for its unique sound and deep spiritual connotation.

historical_references.reference: Azrik of Syrian Antioch, also known as St. Azarius, was a 4th-century Syrian Christian bishop who is venerated as a saint. He is said to have been born in Antioch and ordained a bishop in the city. Azrik is known for his role in the defense of Antioch during the Persian invasion in 363 AD, during which he is said to have miraculously healed the wounded and provided food and water to the besieged population. He is also said to have converted the Persian general, Urkish, to Christianity.

Azrik of Cappadocia, also known as St. Azaryas, was a 5th-century Christian ascetic and hermit. He is said to have lived in a cave near the town of Mazaka in Cappadocia and was known for his spiritual writings and his holiness. Azrik is said to have been a disciple of St. Simeon Stylites, the famous ascetic who lived on a pillar for many years. He is venerated as a saint and is particularly remembered for his prayers and intercessions on behalf of the sick and the poor.
